Neighborhoods & Communities We Serve

A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service works in neighborhoods across the entire Omaha metro. Whether you live in a historic Midtown bungalow or a new build in West Omaha, we know the area and we know the work. Below is a breakdown of the communities and subdivisions where our crews are active every week.

Midtown Omaha

The heart of Omaha, from the tree-lined streets of Dundee to the bustling Blackstone District. Our crews handle everything from mature tree trimming in older neighborhoods to full junk removal for estate cleanouts in these established communities.

Neighborhoods: Dundee, Happy Hollow, Blackstone, Morton Meadows, Gifford Park, Country Club, Field Club

Downtown & North Omaha

From the historic Old Market to the revitalized NoDo district and the established neighborhoods of Florence and Miller Park. We provide junk removal, tree service, and landscaping throughout North Omaha and the downtown corridor.

Neighborhoods: Old Market, Little Bohemia, NoDo, Florence, Miller Park, Minne Lusa, Bemis Park

South Omaha

South Omaha's tight-knit communities from Little Italy to Deer Park keep us busy with residential cleanouts, yard work, and tree maintenance. We know these neighborhoods well and work in them regularly.

Neighborhoods: Little Italy, Dahlman, Deer Park, Columbus Park, Spring Lake

West Omaha & Elkhorn

West Omaha and Elkhorn are among our busiest service areas. Newer subdivisions with growing trees, active families, and homeowners who want their properties looking sharp. We handle lawn care, tree trimming, junk hauling, and everything in between across the Westside corridor.

Neighborhoods & Subdivisions: Regency, Rockbrook, Harvey Oaks, Pacific Springs, Linden Estates, Westside (District 66)

Northwest Omaha & Bennington

The fast-growing northwest corridor including Bennington and the Standing Bear area. New construction means new landscaping needs, and established homes around Lake Cunningham keep our tree crews busy year-round.

Neighborhoods & Subdivisions: Standing Bear, Lake Cunningham, Sunny Slope, Saddle Hills

Southwest Omaha & Millard

Millard and the surrounding southwest Omaha neighborhoods are home to families who take pride in their properties. From seasonal cleanups in Oak Hills to tree removal in Stonybrook, we serve this area daily.

Neighborhoods & Subdivisions: Millard, Chalco, Oak Hills, Stonybrook, Huntington Park

Satellite Cities & Surrounding Areas

Our service area extends well beyond Omaha city limits. We regularly work in these surrounding communities across both Nebraska and Iowa.

Sarpy County

Sarpy County is one of the fastest-growing areas in Nebraska, and we serve every corner of it. From Bellevue and Papillion to La Vista and Gretna, our crews are in these communities every single day. We also serve the neighborhoods around Offutt Air Force Base and the newer developments south of Highway 370.

Cities: Bellevue, Papillion, La Vista, Gretna, Springfield, Ralston

Subdivisions & Areas: Offutt AFB, Fontenelle Hills, Two Springs, North Shore, Shadow Lake, Walnut Creek, Val Verde, Cimarron, Southwind, Aspen Creek, Hidden Hollow, Tiburon

Western Edge

Valley and Waterloo sit on the western edge of our service area. These rural and semi-rural communities have larger properties that often need land clearing, tree removal, and brush cleanup that the bigger franchises won't touch.

Cities: Valley, Waterloo

Subdivisions & Areas: Ginger Cove, Mallard Landing, Riverside, West Shores

Iowa (Pottawattamie County)

We cross the river into Iowa for Council Bluffs and Carter Lake. These communities are part of the Omaha metro and we treat them the same as any Nebraska job — same pricing, same service, same crew.

Cities: Council Bluffs, Carter Lake

Areas: Shoreline Drive

Don't See Your Neighborhood?

If your neighborhood or subdivision isn't listed above, don't worry — we probably still serve your area. Our coverage extends throughout the greater Omaha metro. Give Bryan a call at (402) 612-2373 and we'll let you know right away if we can get to you.
